description: Circuit breaker zeroes consecutive successes during HALF_OPEN probe requests, preventing transition back to CLOSED state.
spec_notes: MeshCircuitBreaker.record_result must increment consecutive_successes and close circuit once threshold is reached.

repo_files.circuit_state.py:
"""Circuit breaker state enumeration."""

class CircuitState:
    CLOSED = "CLOSED"
    OPEN = "OPEN"
    HALF_OPEN = "HALF_OPEN"

tests.test_circuit_oscillation.py:
from circuit_breaker import MeshCircuitBreaker
from circuit_state import CircuitState
from mesh_proxy import MeshProxy


def test_half_open_recovers_to_closed_after_success_threshold():
    cb = MeshCircuitBreaker(failure_threshold=2, success_threshold=3, cooldown_sec=5.0)
    proxy = MeshProxy(cb)
    # Trip to OPEN
    proxy.send(100.0, lambda: False)
    proxy.send(100.0, lambda: False)
    assert cb.state == CircuitState.OPEN

    # Probe at t=106 (cooldown elapsed) enters HALF_OPEN
    assert proxy.send(106.0, lambda: True) is True
    assert cb.state == CircuitState.HALF_OPEN
    assert cb.consecutive_successes == 1

    # 2nd and 3rd successes reach success_threshold=3 and CLOSE circuit
    proxy.send(107.0, lambda: True)
    proxy.send(108.0, lambda: True)
    assert cb.state == CircuitState.CLOSED
    assert cb.consecutive_failures == 0


def test_single_failure_in_half_open_reopens_immediately():
    cb = MeshCircuitBreaker(failure_threshold=2, success_threshold=3, cooldown_sec=5.0)
    proxy = MeshProxy(cb)
    proxy.send(100.0, lambda: False)
    proxy.send(100.0, lambda: False)
    # Probe succeeds
    proxy.send(106.0, lambda: True)
    # Subsequent probe fails -> re-trips to OPEN
    proxy.send(107.0, lambda: False)
    assert cb.state == CircuitState.OPEN
